origin.category: hardcoded engineering resource limit, not native traffic safety predicate
origin.absence_scope: targeted runner/card/technical review sources; no claim exhaustive private communications search

planning_arithmetic.formula: startup + observed native duration * target simulation steps / observed completed steps
planning_arithmetic.classification: whole-prefix linear planning illustration, not prediction/upper bound/confidence interval
planning_arithmetic.limits: last 50 steps include new admission/control phases and increasing population; startup/native timers differ from bridge wall; no measured marginal cost; native dynamics may alter errors/safety outcomes; no guarantee300 reaches1207

recommendation: one finite300s proposed limit instead of further complex optimization; leave full monitored semantics/1207 stop unchanged, stop again on any safety/log/resource uncertainty; no retry or expansion beyond authorized new identity

wall_clock_scope.starts: started=time.monotonic() after static gates, output allocation/source snapshots; before LogCapture/worker import/native spawn/connect
wall_clock_scope.includes: startup, connection, phase/observer/log/resource/ACK/reconciliation work to target; watchdog may remain active through cleanup
wall_clock_scope.excludes: earlier offline prepare/static environment review, initial source snapshotting before started, post watchdog-close final log capture and receipt writing
wall_clock_scope.enforcement: synchronous between-step <= limit, independent .2s sampledwatchdog > limit; not hard-real-time max entire CLI duration
